title: ipomoea angularis
intro: Ipomoea angularis, commonly known as the Japanese morning glory or ipomoea, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Convolvulaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. The therapeutic actions of Ipomoea angularis include its ability to reduce pain, lower fever, and combat oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
